# lokalise_contributor (Resource)

A contributor on a Lokalise project. This resource manages exactly the contributor it created; it never removes any other contributor. The token's own user is a contributor on every project it can see, and this resource can manage it, but removing it is almost certainly not what you want.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "lokalise_permission_template" "translator" {
  team_id = lokalise_project.example.team_id
  name    = "Translator"
}

resource "lokalise_contributor" "french_translator" {
  project_id = lokalise_project.example.id
  email      = "translator@example.com"

  # fullname is only used when inviting a brand-new Lokalise user; it has no
  # effect for an email that is already a Lokalise user.
  # fullname = "Jane Doe"

  # Exactly one of role_id or admin_rights must be set.
  role_id = data.lokalise_permission_template.translator.role_id
  # admin_rights = ["upload", "download"]

  languages = [
    { lang_iso = "fr", is_writable = true },
  ]
}

# WARNING: the API token's own user is a contributor on every project it can
# see. Managing that contributor with this resource is allowed, but removing
# it (destroying the resource, or narrowing its languages/rights) can lock
# the token out of the project.
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) Contributor's email address, matched case-insensitively against the API. Changing it (other than its case) forces a new resource.
- `languages` (Attributes Set) Languages this contributor may access. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--languages))
- `project_id` (String) Lokalise project ID. Changing it forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `admin_rights` (Set of String) Explicit set of admin rights to assign. Conflicts with `role_id`; exactly one of the two must be set.
- `fullname` (String) Full name to use when inviting a new user. Has no effect for an email that is already a Lokalise user. Only used on invite: it is not read back from the API afterwards, and changing it only updates state.
- `role_id` (Number) Permission template ID to assign (see `lokalise_permission_template`). Conflicts with `admin_rights`; exactly one of the two must be set.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `project_id:user_id`.
- `user_id` (Number) Lokalise user ID of the contributor.

<a id="nestedatt--languages"></a>
### Nested Schema for `languages`

Required:

- `is_writable` (Boolean) Whether the contributor may write translations in this language.
- `lang_iso` (String) Language code, e.g. `fr`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import lokalise_contributor.french_translator <project_id>:<email>
```
